entities.summary: The Real Alternative Party, formerly the Party for the Restructured Antilles until 2016, is a political party in Curaçao. With two seats, the party is the third largest party in the Parliament of Curaçao, following the 2025 elections. Real Alternative Party is a political party in Willemstad, established in 1993. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
